abstract: Spatial audio question answering requires associating sound identities with locations and reasoning about their relations. This paper introduces SciPhi-Chat, a spatial audio agent that answers questions, conducts multi-turn dialogue, and calls tools on first-order ambisonic recordings. The accompanying MASU benchmark contains 12,000 samples across 42 task categories, the widest task coverage of any spatial model, with real recordings and simulated audio scenes. SciPhi-Chat achieves a score of 44.9%, 7.4 percentage points above the previous state-of-the-art. On the external ASA-Bench, SciPhi-Chat achieves 74.5% azimuth and 60.0% elevation accuracy, the highest among locally evaluated models. Removing reasoning supervision reduces ASA-Bench accuracy by 17.4 percentage points. All materials will be released via https://github.com/microsoft/sciphi-chat

oneSentenceThesis: 论文要解决用一阶 Ambisonic 录音把声音身份和方向关联并回答关系问题，方法是冻结双路音频编码加小规模投影与适配器并生成先推理后结构化描述再回答的对话轨迹，在包含真实与仿真场景的 MASU 上得到 44.9% 单轮总分，主要代价是 5.50M 对话的仿真与大模型生成和约八卡四天的微调。
originalTitle: SciPhi-Chat: Training a Spatial Audio Agent for Question Answering, Dialogue, and Tool Use
readerTitle: SciPhi-Chat：能听方向、能对话、能调工具的空间音频智能体
